title: penstemon alpinus subsp. magnus
intro: Penstemon alpinus subsp. magnus, commonly known as the Alpine Penstemon, is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Penstemon alpinus subsp. magnus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
